change_interpretations.engineering_summary: Requirement VCU-MOD-06 governing Comfort and Sport driving modes and torque ramp profile selection has been removed. Mode selection verification and profile differentiation are no longer part of the specification.

assessments.reason: Test verifies driver torque response time under requirement VCU-DR-01, which remains unchanged.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test evaluates emergency brake priority over pedal demand under unchanged requirements VCU-BRK-03 and VCU-DR-01.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test evaluates high-load torque transients and is unrelated to the removed operating mode requirement VCU-MOD-06.
evidence: procedure: Sweep demand 75–95% at nominal and high-load cases; recorded maximum 92 ms.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test assesses emergency brake actuator latency under VCU-BRK-03, which is unchanged.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test checks wheel-speed sensor degradation behavior against unchanged requirement VCU-DGN-04.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: The procedure explicitly triggers a Comfort to Sport mode transition, but requirement VCU-MOD-06 defining these modes has been removed.
evidence: procedure: Change Comfort to Sport; log timestamp and build identifier.
assessments.recommended_action: Consult owner to update procedure stimuli or clarify mode change verification following the removal of VCU-MOD-06.

assessments.reason: Test covers thermal load acceleration response, which is independent of the removed operating mode requirement VCU-MOD-06.
evidence: procedure: At 80% pedal and elevated load, check that torque delivery is consistent with vehicle response definition.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test covers legacy diagnostic trace replaying and is unaffected by the removal of VCU-MOD-06.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test specifically measures Sport vs Comfort torque ramp profiles under VCU-MOD-06, which has been removed from the specification.
evidence: procedure: Compare accelerator response under Sport vs Comfort during ramp and release.
assessments.recommended_action: Request owner decision to retire or re-scope this test given the removal of requirement VCU-MOD-06.

assessments.reason: Test verifies pedal signal spike filtering under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-02.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test verifies torque cancellation upon emergency braking under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Test evaluates ECU wake-up timing and is unrelated to operating mode selection in VCU-MOD-06.
evidence: procedure: Power cycle the ECU; verify readiness within 500 ms.
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.
